title: Destiny Island
description:
Destiny Island - is a meditative walking simulator where you play a man who visits his memories in a elevator. You can walk, talk and try to understand events that got you here.

• Have a conversation with the ghosts of your past

• Reflect on the questions of the life and religion

• Listen to the music growning with you

• Find a meaning of your life

Conversations are based on the "The Seven Deadly Sins and the Four Last Things", painting attributed to Hieronymus Bosch.
description_short: Destiny Island is a very short computer game. You play a man who visits his memories. You can walk and talk to mannequins about 7 sins. Associate essence with anything comes to your mind.
